bagPolicy.summary: Delta Center does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking at the Delta Center offers a variety of options, including both covered and uncovered stalls. Prices and availability vary, with some lots offering game-by-game passes and others providing free parking for a limited time. TRAX is also available for free within the downtown zone, but stops running at midnight.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Delta Center's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Delta Center varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Sensory Bags can be checked out at Guest Services located on the Main Concourse across from Portal Y/Door 4 free of charge.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Delta Center's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Delta Center. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Delta Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
